exercises.title: Add a strongly typed domain value
exercises.objective: Add a validated domain value without coupling the domain layer to a framework.
acceptance_criteria: Reject invalid values with a domain exception.
Preserve immutability and deterministic equality.
Keep architecture-boundary tests passing.

exercises.title: Implement a market-data provider adapter
exercises.objective: Add a provider behind the existing SDK while preserving raw payloads and declared limits.
acceptance_criteria: Declare capabilities before network access.
Pass the provider contract test suite.
Redact credentials and bound retries.

exercises.title: Add a point-in-time feature
exercises.objective: Create a versioned feature that cannot observe information after its decision cutoff.
acceptance_criteria: Declare lookback and missing-value behavior.
Return exact source-bar lineage.
Include a test that injects future data and proves it is ignored.

exercises.title: Implement a model plugin
exercises.objective: Add a model through the plugin SDK and compare it with mandatory baselines.
acceptance_criteria: Implement fit, predict, save/load health checks, and deterministic seeding.
Report performance against every mandatory baseline.
Do not inspect the final holdout during tuning.

exercises.title: Add a bounded deep-learning candidate
exercises.objective: Add an optional neural candidate without weakening baseline, reproducibility, or artifact controls.
acceptance_criteria: Pin random seeds and record hardware/runtime metadata.
Bound epochs, memory, and search budget.
Reject promotion when the model does not beat simple baselines.

exercises.title: Improve the execution-cost model
exercises.objective: Add a transparent, testable liquidity-aware paper execution policy.
acceptance_criteria: Never fill before a signal is available.
Conserve cash and positions under partial fills.
Demonstrate net results after all configured costs.

exercises.title: Add a governed drift detector
exercises.objective: Introduce a versioned drift metric with evidence, alert thresholds, and retraining behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Define minimum samples and warning/critical thresholds.
Persist evidence independently of an alerting vendor.
Keep human approval required for production promotion.

exercises.title: Extend a cloud deployment module
exercises.objective: Extend one cloud reference deployment while preserving private networking and managed identity.
acceptance_criteria: Store no credentials in Terraform state inputs or source code.
Expose only documented outputs.
Run formatting, validation, and infrastructure security checks.

exercises.title: Replicate and challenge a forecasting result
exercises.objective: Reproduce a result, register all trials, and test whether it survives alternate periods and costs.
acceptance_criteria: Register unsuccessful as well as successful experiments.
Preserve one untouched holdout.
Report uncertainty, costs, limitations, and failed hypotheses.
